report_title: Final commitment: count aggregation and one-sided integrality relaxation
reformulation: Solver-blind exact reformulation of test78 (MPS NAME test78, 3,472 binary vars / 4,633 all-L rows, minimize): delete the 768 single-implication source columns together with their 768 implication rows, make the 1,280 remaining source columns continuous on [0,1], and add 16 continuous pools pool_g in [0,48] (objective -1) with rows pool_g - sum_z d_gz*z <= 0; each capacity row then sums its retained sources plus pool_g <= 9. All 1,424 auxiliary binaries, their 89 at-most-one rows and the remaining implication rows are kept. Target is 2,720 vars / 3,881 rows (NAME test78R).
claim_class: Two complete mixed-integer maps (RPA 7, no bijection, no LP or equality claim): forward source->target with objective 'Equal' and reverse target->source with 'NonIncreasing', both projecting onto the same 1,424 auxiliary binaries; 12,170 + 16,474 = 28,644 terminal obligations. The report states the raw feasible sets in original coordinates are NOT identical (1,280 retained objective variables are now continuous) and that reconstruction recovers integral original decisions.

shape.source: 3,472 vars, all binary (INTORG/INTEND, explicit UP 1, default LO 0), 4,633 rows = 4,528 implications source-aux<=0 + 16 capacity rows (128 sources each, RHS 9, disjoint) + 89 at-most-one rows (16 auxiliaries each, RHS 1, disjoint), 12,528 nonzeros; objective min with 2,048 coefficients -1 and 1,424 zeros; 931,756 B, sha256 adbf507a92ab25d9d6368a38e674148a4f17ff0f9a9d4667787fd3ff084108f3
shape.target: 2,720 vars = 1,424 retained binaries + 1,280 relaxed continuous choices + 16 continuous pools [0,48]; 3,881 rows; 10,928 nonzeros; NAME test78R, 607,519 B; source bytes hash-verified unchanged

edit_summary: Six structured edit families: delete 768 columns and their 768 rows; relax 1,280 columns to continuous keeping [0,1]; add 16 pool columns (objective -1, bounds [0,48]); add 16 rows pool_g - sum_z d_gz*z <= 0 (42 auxiliary coefficients each: 576 entries -1, 96 entries -2); add +1*pool_g to each of the 16 capacity rows; leave the 89 at-most-one rows, the 1,424 auxiliary binaries, the retained implication rows and every other objective coefficient untouched, with no objective constant.
claims: Only 2 claims, hand-written: forward {reverse:False, input_integers:True, output_integers:True, objective:'Equal'} and reverse {reverse:True, objective:'NonIncreasing'}, each carrying a 1,424-pair projection list that is transposed between the directions (tools/prepare_test78.py:270-275); request.json is 34,411 B of exactly these two dicts.

Obligations 12,170 (forward) + 16,474 (reverse) = 28,644 terminal obligations, 11,344 local branches, 55,606,781 charged work units, 28,711 peak live facts, 13,641,664 linear terms (cases/test78/preparation.json counts and verify statistics).
No LP equivalence, bijection, inverse function or numerical optimum is claimed, and no raw original-coordinate projection is claimed (cases/test78/README.md:3-9).
Forward map = identity plus 16 sums of the deleted members; reverse map reconstructs the 128-long prefix counts capped at 9 and takes consecutive differences (tools/prepare_test78.py:82-96, 209-267).
proof_encoding: RPA 7 on 2 text lines: 105,561,392 B -> proof.rpx 92,054,445 B; assemble 1.391 s, verify 3.072 s execution / 3.621 s total (cases/test78/preparation.json kernel_runs[2-3]).
Step census measured on cases/test78/proof.rpa: 116,113 Lin, 35,312 EqPair, 15,200 Round, 11,344 Cases, 22,688 Witness refs, exactly 1 IntervalLift, 1 MenuLift and 2 Return blocks.

The 1,280 IntervalWitnesses materialise 1,280 variables / 6,320 rows / 13,840 terms and the 1,904 MenuWitnesses 133,280 variables / 3,808 rows / 392,192 terms (verify statistics, cases/test78/preparation.json:90).
Reverse block is one IntervalLift wrapping one MenuLift wrapping Return; the forward block is a bare Return with no lift (tools/prepare_test78.py:96, 267).
All 1,904 menus carry the same 6-ref checks list ['Exact','Exact','Exact',lo,hi,integer] and are expanded literally; there are no macros or helper theorems (tools/prepare_test78.py:154).
agent_manual_work: 22 turns / 22 tool calls / 1 failing call / 683.3 s wall / 34,663 input tokens; 16 eval cells of 49,570 chars of exact-Fraction Python, and the framework-member census is empty - the run never touched a kernel API (/tmp/rpx-digests/test78.md header and census).

Wrote two independent MPS decoders (token and positional) after the strict fixed-format decoder died on 'Invalid literal for Fraction: <empty>', then cross-checked all 22,787 data records (/tmp/rpx-digests/test78.md eval 'Verifying free-format input records').

Classified the whole matrix by hand: 2,048 vs 1,424 objective split, 4,528 implications, 16 capacity + 89 packing rows, 768 single-implication leaves, 1,280 residual, plus exhaustive asserts over all 3,472 columns (/tmp/rpx-digests/test78.md eval 'Establishing complete transformation invariants').

Built 105 row-necessity witnesses (10 sources per capacity row, one exclusive node pair per packing row) checked against every original row, to reject dropping rows rather than to certify the committed edit (/tmp/rpx-digests/test78.md eval 'Falsifying direct packing-row redundancy').

Serialized the 607,519 B target MPS by hand and re-decoded it with both parsers, then ran 97 reconstruction cases and 113 local rounding cases and shipped audit.json (235,827 B) and verify.py (9,128 B) (/tmp/rpx-digests/test78.md evals 'Writing and independently checking final MPS', 'Exercising exact rounding and original reconstruction').

availability() hand-builds the 1,280 IntervalWitnesses with p*q compatibility refs and recursive binary Cases for INT a and old x<=a (tools/prepare_test78.py:97-141); the extension layout it addresses is replicated by prepare_test23.py:15-31 extend().

menus_for_prefixes() emits the 1,904 MenuWitness dicts and predicts the kernel layout with start=len(m['vars']) plus K+1 appended vars and 2 rows (tools/prepare_test78.py:142-168); menu_upper/min_low/min_high derive the clamp facts with Round+EqPair+Lin (tools/prepare_test78.py:170-207).

inspect() re-derives the whole edit from the two MPS files and cross-checks audit.json (tools/prepare_test78.py:47-81); emit_checks enumerates obligations (tools/prepare_test48.py:106-127); main() writes RPA/request by hand and runs 6 mutation attacks (tools/prepare_test78.py:283-320).
friction: The kernel's extension layout is duplicated in Python: three independent copies of 'append K+1 menu vars + 2 rows, remember start=len(vars)' exist in this family (tools/prepare_test78.py:155-160, tools/prepare_test72.py:24-33, tools/prepare_test13.py:44), so a kernel layout change breaks refs silently.

The binding from finding to claim is untyped hint keys: only h['removed_variables'] and h['pools'] are consumed (tools/prepare_test78.py:96-101); everything else is re-derived and asserted by hand (tools/prepare_test78.py:47-81).

No shared fact table exists: the construction plan demands passing the old lookup into the extended Proof 'to avoid building a large redundant fact dictionary', and menus_for_prefixes re-seats counter/facts/lookup by hand (audit/test78_plan.md; tools/prepare_test78.py:165).

Nothing preflights cost before emitting text: 177,921 allocated ids, 13,641,664 linear terms and 28,644 obligations are only counted after the 100.7 MB RPA exists (tools/prepare_test78.py:265-266; cases/test78/preparation.json counts).

Rejections are weakly located: all 6 mutants come back as bare messages such as 'INVALID fact reference or type' or 'INVALID obligation mismatch: expected Le', without the location{claim,point,block,step,obligation} payload (cases/test78/preparation.json negative_checks).

notes: A 1,714-line generator web (7 modules) prints a 105.6 MB RPA to certify an edit of 768 column deletions, 1,280 integrality relaxations and 16 count pools; the work is nearly all rule JSON, since 1,904 menus, 133,280 kernel-made variables and 28,644 obligations are expanded literally. The six gaps this case argues for - typed rule builders that return generated layout ids, batch families for the homogeneous menu/prefix families, a typed edit list bound to the finding, one reusable builder+lemma library instead of importing sibling test preparers, incidence/class queries over the sparse model, and a typed readback of the canonical model - are exactly the code that has been copied into the dependency web.
